assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: A six-style comparison of this individual source photograph for the Art Skill README
Primary request: A wide view across dark gently rippling water toward low island silhouettes beneath an expansive sunset sky. The horizon sits low, with a larger dark headland at the left edge, layered orange, coral, gold and purple clouds and a tiny distant boat near the right horizon.
Style/medium: quiet minimal raster still life or editorial backdrop
Color palette: #F3EFE5, #DED8CC, #B8B0A1, #524D43
Materials/textures: subtle matte paper or plaster texture, restrained grain
Composition/framing: sparse subject placement, calm margins and ample empty space; Keep landscape orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse light with delicate warm-neutral shadows
Requested output target: 1536x1024, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original low horizon, open water, dark left headland, low islands and sweeping layered sunset clouds. The sky dominates. Do not add a garden, terrace, trees or a towering central cloud.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
